species.name: Gorilla
mustRead: peaked skull crest over a heavy brow ridge
barrel chest with a wide pot belly
knuckle-walking on folded hands
species.note: arms are markedly longer than the legs, so the shoulders sit higher than the hips

species.name: Orangutan
mustRead: shaggy long orange-red hair
enormous arm span with short bowed legs
wide cheek flanges on adult males

species.name: Capuchin
mustRead: dark cap of hair over a pale pink face
long curling prehensile tail
small slender body with pale shoulders

species.name: Howler Monkey
mustRead: swollen bearded throat pouch
thick prehensile tail with a bare gripping tip
hunched stocky shoulders and short muzzle

species.name: Spider Monkey
mustRead: extremely long spindly limbs
prehensile tail longer than the whole body
small round head with a pot belly
species.note: the hands have no functional thumb - they are hooks

species.name: Tamarin
mustRead: squirrel-sized body with a long thin tail
facial mane, crest or drooping moustache
clawed fingers gripping a thin branch
species.note: generic representative: a cotton-top / emperor tamarin type. The tail is long but NOT prehensile

species.name: Macaque
mustRead: bare pink or red face with a short muzzle
short to medium tail
stocky dog-postured body on all fours
species.note: generic representative: a rhesus/bonnet macaque type

species.name: Langur
mustRead: tail far longer than the body
black face and hands framed by pale grey fur
slender long-limbed build with a crest on the crown

species.name: Baboon
mustRead: long dog-like muzzle with close-set eyes
tail kinked sharply upward at the base then hanging down
cape of long hair over the shoulders in males
species.note: the tail has a distinctive broken/kinked profile, not a smooth curve

species.name: Monkey
mustRead: long curling tail as long as the body
grasping hands and feet with opposable thumbs
flat forward-facing face with round eyes
species.note: Generic name - interpreted as a macaque/capuchin-type monkey (tailed, not an ape).

species.name: Lemur
mustRead: black-and-white ringed tail longer than the body
fox-like muzzle with a black mask
bright orange-gold staring eyes
species.note: Generic - interpreted as the ring-tailed lemur, the representative member of the group.

species.name: Gibbon
mustRead: arms far longer than the legs, reaching the ground
long hook-shaped hands
no tail at all
species.note: An ape, not a monkey - tailless, and the arm span is the dominant proportion.

species.name: Mandrill
mustRead: scarlet nose stripe flanked by ridged blue cheeks
olive mane over hunched high shoulders
tiny stub tail held upright
species.note: Has a stump tail, not a long one; the muzzle is deep and ridged like a dog's, not flat.

species.name: Marmoset
mustRead: white fan-shaped ear tufts
squirrel-sized body clinging upright to bark
long banded tail that cannot grip

species.name: Aye-Aye
mustRead: enormous naked bat-like ears
skeletal elongated wire-thin middle finger
huge shaggy tail bigger than the body

species.name: Proboscis Monkey
mustRead: huge drooping pendulous nose hanging over the mouth
round pot belly
orange-brown back with pale grey limbs and tail
